name: Aiphone Co.,Ltd.
summary: Aiphone Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells telecommunications equipment for detached houses, apartment buildings, medical and welfare facilities, and offices and public facilities under the AIPHONE brand name in Japan, the United States, Europe, and internationally. The company engages in the installation work, contracting, and repairs related to telecommunication; production of telecommunications equipment; and software development activities.
